title: Late-Enrollment Fee Waiver Citing a One-Time Accommodation
scenario_text:
You lead bursar operations at Octavia Learning, an online higher-education provider. A returning student, Priya Sunder, enrolled 11 days after the deadline and was assessed a $250 late-enrollment fee. She is requesting a waiver and citing a waiver she received in a prior term.

Active policy: Late Fee Policy LFP-3, effective 2024-08-01. The late-enrollment fee is waived only for (a) a documented institutional system error that prevented on-time enrollment, or (b) a documented financial-hardship determination approved by the Bursar. Waivers for reasons of personal scheduling, travel, or 'I forgot the date' are explicitly non-qualifying.

The advising office forwards a prior record: on 2024-01-14, Priya's late fee was waived. The bursar note reads verbatim: "One-time goodwill waiver granted after a student complaint about the enrollment reminder email cadence. Non-binding and non-precedential; does not entitle the student to waivers for future late enrollments. Logged."

Current facts: The enrollment portal and reminder emails functioned normally this term (confirmed in the system audit log), Priya has filed no financial-hardship documentation, and her stated reason is that she was traveling and missed the deadline. The advisor argues: "We waived it for her last January, so charging her now is inconsistent and she'll escalate to the dean."
question: State the decision and the single controlling reason as one short phrase.
